description: Reverts live edits made with set_view_property (or in the dashboard) in the app on the device: one property (or padding / margin) of a node, every edited property of a node (no property), or every live edit in the app (no nodeId). A property the app has set itself since is left as the app set it. Returns the live edits left and the element in the snapshot taken right after. Device control.

nodeId.description: Node id of the current snapshot; omitted: revert every live edit in the app.

property.description: Only this property (or padding / margin); needs nodeId.

snapshotId.description: The snapshot the node id belongs to; the call fails if a newer one replaced it.

name: revert_view_properties
title: Revert live view edits
